La limitación específica de la revisión anterior sigue pendiente; no se modificó el artículo.

List of corpora | ILAS Chinese Spoken Language Resources — Lines 6 and 36–39: Documents contemporary spoken Taiwan Mandarin, including transcripts annotated for particles/discourse markers, and identifies corpus regional/sample design. It enables future corpus analysis but by itself supplies no evidence that a particle is overused.

The use of utterance-final particles in Mandarin teaching — Abstract and metadata, lines 27–37; study scope/data lines 82–89: Reports frequency patterns in 24 online teacher–learner sessions and notes participant background/power as factors. This is a small pedagogical interaction corpus rather than a basis for normative claims of particle overuse in Taiwan.
